rule: Fill-path only, mapped by sheet geometry: each join targets the fillable cell whose printed caption (from the frozen page's own text layer) names the item. The eBIRForms page is the older 1606 layout, so items are matched by meaning, not number. Peso amounts split into the peso comb and the 2-slot cents comb; Schedule amounts in single text cells print the writer's official text (1,234.56). Values the sheet prints differently from the submitted controls (whole TINs, the WI/WC box for seller type and rate, rate digits, Schedule 3 Item 1A for foreclosures) come from derived: keys of to_print_field_map, never from the submitted XML. Unexposed or unmatched items stay blank on print; the submitted XML always carries them. Since #113: one writer key may fill several cells (Item 12 and Schedule 3 item 2 share txtTax); Schedule 1 prints the lot (row 1) and improvement (row 2) with their higher FMV and total, and Item 11 its specify text, from derived: keys. The older layout's items with no counterpart on the 2018 sheet are listed in not_joined.
